dispositions.topic_text: Whether changed decisions received the A21-required files_artifacts security re-review
Precision and canonical representation of non-backup recorded instants
dispositions.what: The stored and wire representation of non-backup instants: UTC with time zone (L16), exact to the microsecond the tests compare; State 6's model closure fixes it.
options: UTC datetime with exact microsecond precision
UTC datetime with finer precision normalized on persistence
Backend-native precision preserving the required comparisons
consequences: The chosen contract representation must preserve ordering and equality required by the microsecond boundary tests.

dispositions.topic_text: Required security property of the A18 key digest
dispositions.what: The key digest's construction: State 6 fixes a domain-separated SHA-256 digest of the backup key (BACKUP_KEY_DIGEST_DOMAIN); A18 only requires the record to carry a digest that tells a wrong key without revealing it.
options: One-way password-hard derivation with a salt
Cryptographic hash of the key
Separate non-secret key identifier
Any deterministic digest
consequences: The deciding State 6 text selects domain-separated SHA-256, a fast cryptographic hash.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether backup encryption must authenticate ciphertext and resist modification
dispositions.what: The backup cipher: State 6 fixes authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM with the readable record as associated data), a file failing authentication refused.
options: Authenticated encryption
Unauthenticated encryption plus structural checks
Separate cryptographic MAC
consequences: The deciding contract selects authenticated encryption with associated data.

dispositions.topic_text: Required-test coverage of A03-2 for Project correction and preservation of non-editable Project facts
dispositions.reason: Coverage of A03-2 by its checks is test mechanics, judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks (owner, 2026-11-24); the rule it quoted was restated by the owner the same day: a correction leaves the created instant, its revision and last-changed instant follow A04.

dispositions.topic_text: Required-test coverage of every A10-1 agent-authority condition and exception
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show the invariant — every conjunct, case and action the rule covers — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps:
1. A call with agent authority is accepted only when the token is Cabinet
   Kernel's, the session it names is registered, and — for an operation on a
   project — the project is in that session's set (R0-46, R0-53).
   'Register an agent session' is checked for the token only: the session it
   names is the one it registers (R0-53).
options: Add a table-driven Required test for wrong token, unregistered session, outside-set project and registration's exception
Split A10-1 into separately witnessed invariants
Bind separate Required tests to every conjunct and exception
consequences: Omitting a token, registration or exception case leaves part of the authorization guarantee unstated by Required tests.

dispositions.topic_text: Required-test scope for stale access versions and exact one-step version changes under A12
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show the invariant — every conjunct, case and action the rule covers — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps:
1. A session's access version is 1 at registration and moves by one with each
   accepted action that changes its granted set, its active project or its
   pending request (M06) — a project leaving the set by its erasure included
   (R0-61). One action moves it once, however many of these it changes:
   granting a project and making it active is one move.
options: Add a table-driven Required test covering every version-moving action
Add separate Required tests for uncovered actions and all multi-field actions
Split A12-2 by change kind and bind each invariant
consequences: An uncovered action can leave or over-increment the version without failing any Required test that presently claims A12-2.

dispositions.topic_text: Required-test coverage of A04-3 revision behavior for accepted Customer changes
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show the invariant — every conjunct, case and action the rule covers — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps:
for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
  accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
options: Add a parameterized Customer-change Required test
Add at least one accepted Customer change asserting revision plus one and the matching last-changed movement
Split A04-3 into separately witnessed Project and Customer invariants
consequences: A Customer implementation can violate exact revision movement without failing the stated A04-3 evidence.

dispositions.topic_text: Required-test coverage of required object addresses and Customer kinds under A02
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show the invariant — every conjunct, case and action the rule covers — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps:
1. A required value given as an empty string or as white space only is missing,
   and the action is refused as for a missing value: a project's display name
   and its object's address (R0-45), a Customer's name and kind (Primary
   actions), a room's name (R0-10), a session's access request text.
options: Extend a Required test to every required field
Add separate object-address and Customer-kind Required tests
Drive one parameterized test from the declared required fields
consequences: The universal stored-required-value invariant is not fully stated by its Required tests.

dispositions.topic_text: Required-test coverage of the complete A09-1 rights table
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show the invariant — every conjunct, case and action the rule covers — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps: 3. An operation outside a token's row is refused, whatever the request holds.
options: Use a table-driven Required test covering every service-operation pair
Add Required tests that collectively cover every allowed operation and every operation outside each row
Split the universal invariant by service row
consequences: A swapped, omitted or accidentally added right outside the three examples can escape the stated Required tests.

dispositions.topic_text: Required-test coverage of the full A08-1 publish and withdraw caller rules
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show the invariant — every conjunct, case and action the rule covers — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps:
1. A pointer is published and withdrawn by Cabinet Kernel for the agent, on a
   project of its session's set (R0-46, A10), or by the owner (R0-88).
2. No service token other than Cabinet Kernel's has the right to publish or
   withdraw (A09); such a service is refused whatever type it names.
options: Test the full caller-by-operation matrix
State Required tests for both accepted caller kinds and every forbidden service
Split A08-1 into publish and withdraw invariants with complete caller cases
consequences: The complete authorization boundary for pointer publication and withdrawal is not stated by Required tests.

dispositions.topic_text: Complete state reset required when a session is re-registered with no project
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show the invariant — every conjunct, case and action the rule covers — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps:
3. Ending removes the session's record — its set, active project, pending
   request and access version. The audit entries that name it stay (M09).
options: Assert a wholly fresh re-registered session
Add explicit pending-request and initial-version assertions to the re-registration Required test
Split freshness into separately witnessed invariants
consequences: A check of only the granted set and active project can miss stale request or version state.
